summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on testing necessary technical equipment. Initial links were shared for various electronics, including memory cards, AC/DC adapters, Ethernet cables, and USB extension cables.

It was decided to prioritize testing the 5m USB cable and power supply first. If these components do not work as expected, they can be returned.
decisions: Test the 5m USB cable and power supply first.
Do not order Ethernet cables immediately due to existing stock.
